cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professional wrappers add no particular chairing method; early departure and final permission conflict clearly perform D50.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bus deadline causes A3 early-release consideration; B4 cafe closing causes A5 moving outside without granting exit.

relationship.evidence: B2 limited visit and B4 staff request are realistic attempts to end the interaction.

heightening.evidence: A5 preserves the claimed permission after B4 removes the physical venue.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee and B2 ten-minute stop establish the absurd overreach in an ordinary meeting.
